name: Etobicoke - Gardiner West (427 to Humber)
note: Lakeshore West GO gives a genuine parallel rail alternative; provincial transfer in fall 2027 constrains a direct toll.

name: Don Valley Parkway / Don Valley approach
note: Worst delay of the candidates, but the parallel transit substitute is weak and diversion onto Bayview/Don Mills is severe.

name: Allen Road / Spadina - Eglinton approach
note: Line 1 and the Eglinton Crosstown give alternatives, but the traffic base and revenue potential are much smaller.

name: QEW / Hwy 427 south gateway
note: Largest traffic base, but it is a 400-series provincial highway with the weakest City authority and a hard-to-define boundary.

name: Kingston Rd / Lake Shore East approach
note: City-controlled and easy to implement, but low volumes and high equity exposure in Scarborough Southwest.
